title: The Half-Life Archive
subtitle: One thousand witnesses. One city rewritten.
premise: In 2149, an immortality network called the Bloom began erasing identity instead of preserving life. One thousand witnesses woke beneath the sealed city of Vanta, each carrying a memory that belonged to someone else.
publicationNote: The archive is a narrative system, not a promise of financial utility. Community decisions can influence selected canon checkpoints.

factions.name: Rustbound
factions.description: Mechanists who bind dead machines to their bodies to preserve function after memory fails.

factions.name: Sporekin
factions.description: Symbionts who believe the Bloom is trying to communicate through mutation.

factions.name: Glass Saints
factions.motto: A memory sealed is a memory saved.
factions.description: Archivists who crystallize memories, accepting that preservation can become imprisonment.

factions.name: Staticborn
factions.description: Listeners who hear broadcasts from timelines that Vanta has already erased.

factions.name: Bone Cartographers
factions.description: Surveyors who reconstruct forbidden geography from the remains of the forgotten.

chapters.title: Funeral Playback
chapters.hook: Subject #0007 wakes while watching footage of his own funeral.

chapters.title: Three Open Capsules
chapters.hook: The Vault contains 1,000 capsules, but only 997 are still occupied.

chapters.title: Do Not Remember
chapters.hook: A warning appears on the wall after every witness looks away.

chapters.title: Borrowed Grief
chapters.hook: Nail remembers the childhood of a Survivor he has never met.

chapters.title: The Red Moon
chapters.hook: The first exterior door opens onto a sky that should not exist.

chapters.title: Mara Is Alive
chapters.hook: A damaged radio repeats one sentence in a dead scientist's voice.

chapters.title: Floor Thirteen
chapters.hook: The elevator reveals a level missing from every architectural record.

chapters.title: Ledger Skin
chapters.hook: A token number burns itself into a witness's arm.

chapters.title: The Missing Walk
chapters.hook: The Vault insists the three absent Subjects are moving inside the facility.

chapters.title: The First Door
chapters.hook: The community chooses one exit; something behind the rejected door begins to scream.

chapters.title: Rust Oath
chapters.hook: The Rustbound offer freedom in exchange for one irreplaceable memory.

chapters.title: Language of Spores
chapters.hook: A Sporekin leader translates the infection's first complete sentence.

chapters.title: Glass Weapon
chapters.hook: The Saints prove a preserved memory can wound the person who lived it.

chapters.title: Tomorrow's Broadcast
chapters.hook: The Staticborn intercept a live transmission dated forty years ahead.

chapters.title: Bone City
chapters.hook: The Cartographers discover Vanta was built over a human skeleton.

chapters.title: Five Records of Nail
chapters.hook: Every faction possesses a different childhood for Subject #0007.

chapters.title: The Empty Portrait
chapters.hook: A Survivor vanishes from every image while ownership remains onchain.

chapters.title: Message from Zero
chapters.hook: The empty token sends a message to its next witness.

chapters.title: War for Thirteen
chapters.hook: The factions converge on the hidden floor and discover it is already open.

chapters.title: Choose a Shelter
chapters.hook: Nail must join one faction, permanently changing who controls the key.

chapters.title: The Stopped Minute
chapters.hook: Every clock in Vanta displays the same impossible time of death.

chapters.title: Class Still in Session
chapters.hook: Children who never age continue a lesson no teacher remembers starting.

chapters.title: Public Names
chapters.hook: Billboards begin publishing the Survivors' private memories.

chapters.title: The Backward Line
chapters.hook: A metro train returns passengers to places that no longer exist.

chapters.title: Warm Laboratory
chapters.hook: Mara Vey's abandoned laboratory contains a fresh cup of coffee.

chapters.title: Subject 1001
chapters.hook: The experiment log lists one more witness than the collection contains.

chapters.title: The Unseen Witness
chapters.hook: Subject 1001 appears in every group photograph but casts no shadow.

chapters.title: Mother at the Market
chapters.hook: Nail finds his mother alive, younger, and certain she never had a child.

chapters.title: Vanta Beyond Vanta
chapters.hook: The city border leads back to the city from the opposite direction.

chapters.title: Archive or Ash
chapters.hook: The community must preserve Mara's files or destroy the only account of the outbreak.

chapters.title: White Masks
chapters.hook: Sterile soldiers enter Vanta without triggering the quarantine.

chapters.title: The Offer
chapters.hook: The Clean promise no cure, only the comfort of forgetting.

chapters.title: Caul's Face
chapters.hook: Director Caul removes his mask and reveals Nail's older face.

chapters.title: Quiet Surrender
chapters.hook: One faction has already traded the Vault key for immunity.

chapters.title: Successful Treatment
chapters.hook: A cured Survivor remains alive but disappears from every record.

chapters.title: Metadata Rifles
chapters.hook: The Clean's weapons target identity instead of flesh.

chapters.title: The Missing Trait
chapters.hook: One visual trait is erased from all one thousand witnesses overnight.

chapters.title: Future Nail
chapters.hook: Mara claims Caul is not Nail's father but his possible future.

chapters.title: A Murder in Advance
chapters.hook: Nail can kill the man he may become before the future is written.

chapters.title: Mercy for Caul
chapters.hook: The community decides whether the Director survives the first confrontation.

chapters.title: The Memory Market
chapters.hook: Vanta's underground opens a market where people sell the lives they remember.

chapters.title: The Last Morning
chapters.hook: A child auctions the final verified memory from before the Bloom.

chapters.title: Wrong Owners
chapters.hook: Every purchased memory belongs to someone other than its seller.

chapters.title: Lot 404
chapters.hook: Subject #0404's complete history is offered to an anonymous bidder.

chapters.title: The Owner's Voice
chapters.hook: The Staticborn hear a voice calling them custodians from outside Vanta.

chapters.title: Birth Record
chapters.hook: Nail buys the memory of his birth and sees Mara on the table.

chapters.title: The Wrong Child
chapters.hook: The newborn in Nail's memory is not Nail.

chapters.title: One Shattered Witness
chapters.hook: The market keeper claims all Subjects are fragments of one testimony.

chapters.title: First Custodian
chapters.hook: The Vault's original owner arrives to reclaim the archive.

chapters.title: Who Keeps the Memory
chapters.hook: The community chooses which faction receives the last unaltered memory.

chapters.title: The Bedrock Signal
chapters.hook: A signal beneath Vanta cannot be muted, copied, or forgotten.

chapters.title: One Thousand Sentences
chapters.hook: The same signal tells every Subject something different.

chapters.title: Map of Noise
chapters.hook: The Cartographers discover the static describes a physical route.

chapters.title: The Older City
chapters.hook: Beneath Vanta lies another city with the same street names.

chapters.title: The Living Ledger
chapters.hook: The Rustbound uncover an engine that records ownership as biological change.

chapters.title: Future Recalculation
chapters.hook: Every transfer causes the engine to rewrite its prediction.

chapters.title: The First Door Opened
chapters.hook: The first external transfer opened a real door beneath the city.

chapters.title: Unwitnessed
chapters.hook: A Subject with no external witness begins fading from Vanta.

chapters.title: Quarantine Chain
chapters.hook: Mara admits the ledger was built to contain something, not preserve anyone.

chapters.title: Cut or Descend
chapters.hook: The community chooses between severing the signal and following it underground.

chapters.title: The Ownership Revolt
chapters.hook: The factions reject a future controlled by people outside their world.

chapters.title: Broken Glass
chapters.hook: The Saints release every sealed memory at once.

chapters.title: False Pasts
chapters.hook: Thousands of believable histories flood Vanta and demand recognition.

chapters.title: Three Nails
chapters.hook: Nail meets three versions of himself, each carrying valid evidence.

chapters.title: Vault Taken
chapters.hook: The Rustbound seize the capsules and begin replacing their controls.

chapters.title: Bloom Weather
chapters.hook: Spore clouds turn the city's atmosphere into a shared nervous system.

chapters.title: The Static Traitor
chapters.hook: The Staticborn leader has been broadcasting for The Clean.

chapters.title: Canonical Death
chapters.hook: A community choice determines which central witness cannot return.

chapters.title: Trait of the Dead
chapters.hook: The lost witness reappears as a mark on another Subject.

chapters.title: Rule Vanta
chapters.hook: The community gives one faction temporary control of the city.

chapters.title: Ocean Above
chapters.hook: The first expedition leaves Vanta and finds an ocean suspended in the sky.

chapters.title: Other Cities
chapters.hook: Vanta is not the last sealed city, only the first to wake.

chapters.title: Vault Chorus
chapters.hook: Distress calls arrive from archives using incompatible histories.

chapters.title: Two Hundred Years Late
chapters.hook: One rescue signal was sent from Vanta's own future.

chapters.title: The Foreign Witness
chapters.hook: A visitor from another archive carries a trait that Vanta erased.

chapters.title: Prototype City
chapters.hook: Nail learns Vanta was built to test whether history could be privately owned.

chapters.title: Decay Engine
chapters.hook: The outside world powers itself with controlled forgetting.

chapters.title: Clean Capital
chapters.hook: The source of The Clean is a city with no living inhabitants.

chapters.title: Archived Citizens
chapters.hook: Personalities without bodies govern the capital through borrowed memories.

chapters.title: Reveal Vanta
chapters.hook: The community decides whether the world learns that Vanta survived.

chapters.title: Mara Never Lived
chapters.hook: Every official record identifies Mara Vey as a synthetic identity.

chapters.title: One Voice
chapters.hook: All archived recordings collapse into the voice of one unknown Subject.

chapters.title: The Ownership Experiment
chapters.hook: The Bloom was designed to preserve property claims, not human life.

chapters.title: Private History
chapters.hook: The wealthy tried to own the only surviving version of the past.

chapters.title: One Thousand Witnesses
chapters.hook: The Subjects are the people whose testimony threatened the official timeline.

chapters.title: Upload Funeral
chapters.hook: Nail's funeral recorded a transfer, not a death.

chapters.title: Caul's Truth
chapters.hook: Director Caul returns with proof that he tried to stop the first rewrite.

chapters.title: External Witnesses
chapters.hook: The Vault identifies collectors as observers capable of stabilizing history.

chapters.title: Retroactive Choice
chapters.hook: Every community decision has already altered details in earlier chapters.

chapters.title: Name the Enemy
chapters.hook: The community names Mara, Caul, or the Vault as the final antagonist.

chapters.title: After the Enemy
chapters.hook: Destroying the chosen enemy causes the edges of the world to dissolve.

chapters.title: Load-Bearing Prison
chapters.hook: The Vault is both the cage and the structure holding Vanta together.

chapters.title: One Thousand Locks
chapters.hook: Each Subject is revealed as a separate quarantine lock.

chapters.title: Different Witnesses
chapters.hook: The locks require one thousand independent attestations to open safely.

chapters.title: The Missing Three
chapters.hook: The absent capsules were removed because they contained commands, not people.
The final Subjects are instructions capable of ending the archive.

chapters.title: Forget Everything
chapters.hook: The last command can free Vanta only by erasing every external witness.

chapters.title: Nail Enters the Archive
chapters.hook: Nail seals himself inside the ledger to preserve one uncontested truth.

chapters.title: The Moon Opens
chapters.hook: The red moon splits, revealing the world outside the simulation.

chapters.title: Only the First City
chapters.hook: Every witness receives the same final message: VANTA WAS ONLY THE FIRST CITY.
